verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is community mentions of an in-browser playground widget on the landing page and browsable examples. Both had usability problems: the code pane showed only a sliver when resized, and examples failed to load on Android Chrome. That gives some hands-on, no-setup exploration, but nothing shows a structured interactive tutorial. Missing for 10: evidence of a guided step-by-step interactive tutorial, first-party documentation of the playground or tutorial, and reliable cross-device behavior.
